name: What is involved in installing a freestanding bathtub?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in installing a freestanding bathtub?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a freestanding bathtub involves several steps, including preparing the space, ensuring proper plumbing connections for water supply and drainage, and securely leveling the tub. Depending on your bathroom's existing layout, this may require re-routing drain lines or reinforcing the floor. Our team at Hometelligent Inc. can assess your current setup in areas like Alameda and Berkeley to determine the necessary modifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Freestanding tub installation involves preparing the space, connecting plumbing for water and drainage, and leveling the tub securely.
